chart.description: P90 Performance over dashboard time window
chart.name: Token overview
chart.programText:
D = histogram('e2e_request_latency_seconds').count(by=['k8s.cluster.name', 'model_name', 'service.name', 'server.address'], over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).publish(label='D')
E = histogram('e2e_request_latency_seconds').rate(by=['k8s.cluster.name', 'model_name', 'service.name', 'server.address']).mean(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).publish(label='E', enable=False)
A = histogram('time_to_first_token_seconds').percentile(pct=95, by=['k8s.cluster.name', 'model_name', 'service.name', 'server.address'], over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).publish(label='A')
B = histogram('time_per_output_token_seconds').percentile(pct=95, by=['k8s.cluster.name', 'model_name', 'service.name', 'server.address'], over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).publish(label='B')
C = histogram('e2e_request_latency_seconds').percentile(pct=90, by=['k8s.cluster.name', 'model_name', 'service.name', 'server.address'], over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).publish(label='C', enable=False)
F = data('request_failure_total').sum(by=['k8s.cluster.name', 'model_name', 'service.name', 'server.address']).sum(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).publish(label='F', enable=False)
G = data('request_success_total', filter=filter('finished_reason', 'stop')).sum(by=['k8s.cluster.name', 'model_name', 'service.name', 'server.address']).sum(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).publish(label='G', enable=False)
H = data('request_success_total', filter=filter('finished_reason', 'length')).sum(by=['k8s.cluster.name', 'model_name', 'service.name', 'server.address']).sum(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).publish(label='H', enable=False)
I = data('num_requests_waiting', rollup='max').sum(by=['k8s.cluster.name', 'model_name', 'service.name', 'server.address']).publish(label='I', enable=False)
J = data('num_requests_waiting', rollup='sum').sum(by=['k8s.cluster.name', 'model_name', 'service.name', 'server.address']).sum(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).publish(label='J', enable=False)
K = data('prompt_tokens_total', rollup='rate').max(by=['k8s.cluster.name', 'model_name', 'service.name', 'server.address']).max(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).publish(label='K')
L = data('prompt_tokens_total').sum(by=['k8s.cluster.name', 'model_name', 'service.name', 'server.address']).sum(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).publish(label='L')
M = data('generation_tokens_total', rollup='rate').max(by=['k8s.cluster.name', 'model_name', 'service.name', 'server.address']).max(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).publish(label='M')
N = data('generation_tokens_total').sum(by=['k8s.cluster.name', 'model_name', 'service.name', 'server.address']).sum(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).publish(label='N')
